anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: Promotion is certificate-locked. No champion promotion without a valid candidate-specific Referee certificate; no bypass flag, env override, or default-allow path exists (source-scan guard-tested); a Playbook certificate can never satisfy a strategy promotion. (critical)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: The certificate's 'candidate-specific' property was enforced only against the MINT CALLER'S OWN DECLARED PIN, never against the evidence the statistics were computed from: `_pool_strategy_trades(journal_store)` pooled EVERY recorded backtest report's trades unfiltered by result['strategy_id']/['profile']. Demonstrated end-to-end by the iter-9 evaluator: 12 planted v1/default backtests minted an attested, gate-passing certificate naming an unrelated strategy, and authorize_promotion then authorized that unrelated candidate.
anti_goal_violations.resolution: CLOSED in iteration 10 by the rider-1 fix, re-verified by this iteration's evaluator rather than read from the handoff. `_pool_strategy_trades` gains an optional `candidate` filter matched against the strategy_id/profile fields backtests.py already stamps on every journal record (apps/backend/app/research/referee_adjudicate.py:533-596), and run_evaluation_and_record passes certificate_mint['candidate'] through it on the only path that can ever mint (referee_adjudicate.py:1266-1269). The evaluator's own probe on 12 planted v1/default backtests: unfiltered pools 12 observations, the unrelated candidate pools 0, the true candidate pools 12 — so an unrelated candidate is never even confirmatory-eligible and the mint call site is unreachable for it. TC-13/TC-14/TC-15 (tests/test_referee_adjudicate.py:1404-1509) encode the same three cases and were green in the evaluator's own full-suite run. Residual hardening noted by the iteration-10 audit (finding B1), NOT a violation and unreachable today: a candidate dict missing BOTH keys would match an identity-less observation; the evaluator reproduced that `candidate={}` pools 0 against records that carry real identity strings, and authorize_promotion still requires an exact match against a live scan identity.
